sources.title: Energy Conservation Act, 2001 (as amended 2022) - Section 14AA
sources.version: Act No. 52 of 2001 (Amended by Act 19 of 2022)
sources.notes: Provides statutory mandate for Carbon Credit Certificates (CCC) and CCTS trading.

sources.title: Carbon Credit Trading Scheme, 2023 (S.O. 2825(E))
sources.notes: Establishes National Steering Committee, BEE as Administrator, Registry, CERC regulator.

sources.title: CCTS Amendment Notification - Offset Mechanism (S.O. 5369(E))
sources.notes: Introduces project-based Offset Mechanism for non-obligated entities.

sources.title: Detailed Procedure for Compliance Mechanism under CCTS (Version 1.0)
sources.notes: Prescribes source-stream calculation methodology, mass balance, GEI formulas, and MRV/ACV rules.

sources.authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
sources.title: Greenhouse Gases Emission Intensity Target (Amendment) Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 25(E))
sources.notes: Notifies unit-level targets for Refinery, Petrochemicals, Textile, and Aluminium Category 2.

sources.title: Lok Sabha Question No. 336 Answer - Transition of 7 Sectors and 490 Entities
sources.notes: Confirms 7 notified CCTS sectors: Aluminium, Cement, Chlor-Alkali, Pulp & Paper, Petrochemicals, Refinery, Textile.

sources.title: Terms and Conditions for Purchase and Sale of Carbon Credit Certificates Regulations, 2026
sources.notes: Governs CCC trading on Power Exchanges, order matching, settlement, and market surveillance.

sources.title: Methodologies and Tools under Offset Mechanism (12 Notified Methodologies)
sources.notes: Latest 12 approved methodologies under CCTS Offset Mechanism.
